name: F1TENTH autonomous racecar
description: 1/10-scale car with lidar and onboard compute that maps a track and races it autonomously using SLAM, pure pursuit and MPC.

name: BLDC motor FOC controller
description: Field-oriented control of a BLDC motor on an STM32 with current sensing.

name: Quadcopter with your own flight controller
description: Write the stabilization loop on an IMU board and fly a full-size frame.

name: Quasi-direct-drive robot arm with custom actuators
description: Design low-gear-ratio BLDC joint actuators with custom FOC drivers on CAN and build a 6-DOF arm with torque-controlled motion.

name: Imitation-learning robot arm
description: Teleoperate a leader-follower arm to record demonstrations then train a policy that performs the task autonomously from camera input.

name: Autonomous navigation with Nav2
description: Send a goal and have the robot plan a path and avoid obstacles.

name: Sim-to-real reinforcement-learning robot
description: Train a balance or locomotion policy with RL in simulation using domain randomization then deploy it on a real robot and measure the sim-to-real gap.

name: Tiny RISC-V soft core
description: Implement a small RISC-V CPU, run programs on it and talk to it over UART.

name: FPGA CNN inference accelerator
description: Design a hardware convolution engine that runs a quantized CNN on camera or image data and benchmark it against a CPU.

name: LQR balancing robot
description: Replace PID with a state-space LQR controller on a balancing robot.

name: Custom-PCB quadruped robot
description: Twelve-actuator quadruped with inverse kinematics, a trot gait, IMU-based body stabilization and a custom controller board.

name: CubeSat-style flatsat with attitude control
description: Build a satellite-style stack with onboard computer, radio telemetry, power system and a reaction-wheel attitude controller on a test rig plus ground-station software.

name: Write a tiny RTOS scheduler
description: Implement task switching and a round-robin scheduler on a Cortex-M core.

name: Minimal embedded Linux with a custom driver
description: Build a small Linux image and write a kernel driver for an I2C sensor.

name: Myoelectric prosthetic hand
description: 3D-printed multi-finger hand driven by EMG signals with an ML gesture classifier and finger force feedback. A research and learning project, not a medical device.

name: Reaction-wheel balancing cube
description: A cube that balances on one corner or edge using reaction wheels and an IMU with a state-space controller.

name: Delta robot with vision sorting
description: Build a parallel-kinematics delta robot with fast pick-and-place driven by camera detection and a conveyor.

name: Multi-robot swarm with UWB localization
description: Several small robots localize with UWB anchors and coordinate formation and task allocation over a mesh network.

name: MPPT solar charge controller
description: Tracks the panel's maximum power point to charge a battery.

name: Four-layer ESP32 board with USB-C
description: Design a compact ESP32 board with USB-C, power protection and an antenna keep-out.
